mutations.name: the shim points into releases/ rather than the current symlink
kills: the titan-console shim a verified swap puts on PATH execs node on the current symlink's cli with every argument passed through, and is executable

mutations.name: the shim drops its arguments
kills: the titan-console shim a verified swap puts on PATH execs node on the current symlink's cli with every argument passed through, and is executable

mutations.name: the shim is not executable
kills: the titan-console shim a verified swap puts on PATH execs node on the current symlink's cli with every argument passed through, and is executable

mutations.name: an unchanged shim is rewritten
kills: the titan-console shim a verified swap puts on PATH leaves an unchanged shim alone on the next update

mutations.name: a failed shim write fails the update
kills: the titan-console shim a verified swap puts on PATH still counts the update as done, and logs why, when the shim cannot be written
